attachments.insertion_landmark: iliotibial tract, continuing to Gerdy's tubercle

actions: flexes, abducts, internally rotates hip; tenses the IT band to stabilize the knee in extension

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Its tendon becomes the iliotibial band's proximal continuation, giving it a functional influence extending all the way to the knee -- a genuine two-joint muscle-tendon unit.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
